title: Additional Information Data Layouts
applicability: Applies to additional information in financial responses associated with Segment 100 requests; controlled by Element 116 and carried in Element 118/Segment 118.

businessRequirements.title: A financial response shall set the Additional Information Data Segment Flag consistently with whether Segment 118 follows.
Additional Information Segment 118 shall use a valid Appendix K Table ID, length, and maximum data layout.
Balance Information Table ID 001 shall use its source-defined fixed layout when a financial response returns balance data.
AVS/NVS Additional Information Table ID 003 shall use the source-defined signed response representation and issuer response code.
Card Verification Additional Information shall use the source-defined Table ID 004 layout when the response returns CVV/CVC/CID/DTVV results.

negative: Flag says absent while Segment 118 follows

testCases.positive: Table ID, length, and data layout are valid
negative: invalid AVS/NVS sign or response code
